title: Block unsafe roadmap task reuse
summary: Change roadmap task-boundary assessment so reuse/refinement requires matching requirement IDs and compatible desired outcomes.

goal.outcome: Roadmap creation and planning reuse reject path-only, label-only, or broad-intent merges that combine unrelated accepted outcomes.
acceptance: Task-boundary assessment requires requirement ID overlap and compatible desired outcomes for auto-reuse/refinement.
Shared spec paths, code paths, labels, or decision build refs alone do not justify merging distinct accepted rows.
Create/refine reporting explains unsafe reuse findings with the conflicting row/outcome evidence.
True duplicate work with matching requirement IDs and outcomes can still refine safely.
TASK-specific tests cover unsafe path/label-only reuse rejection and safe requirement/outcome overlap reuse.
non_goals: Do not implement planning coverage residuals.
Do not change closed or archived roadmap history.
Do not add file-structure target accountability findings.
verification: targeted TASK-112 test for task-boundary reuse

delta.desired: Roadmap auto-reuse requires requirement/outcome overlap and reports unsafe boundary findings.
delta.current: Roadmap auto-reuse can merge distinct work by shared refs, labels, paths, or broad intent.
delta.closure: Closed when overmerge regression tests fail before fix and pass after fix.
